about: I'm in the final year of a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering with an AI specialization. Most of my learning happens by shipping projects: I like problems where the data is messy and the answer has to be defended to someone who isn't technical.

My recent work covers reinforcement learning (a DQN written from scratch), analytics pipelines with tests and data-quality checks, time-series forecasting, and LLM-powered tools such as a read-only text-to-SQL assistant.
